text: Main Content Current Undergraduate We're here to help you gather as many financial resources as possible toward your investment in a TCU education. Not just as a new student, but for the duration of your time as a Horned Frog. Reminders Log on to my.tcu.edu to check requested information under the financial aid icon. Please complete all requested information for timely disbursements of financial aid. Don’t forget to update your privacy permissions each academic year. Review your list of Important Dates . Every Year, Without Delay Since college costs and household financial situations vary from year to year, the FAFSA must also be updated yearly. And because some financial aid is awarded on a first come, first served basis, you'll want to complete your FAFSA by the priority funding date, May 1. For this reason, it's important for you and/or your family to file income tax returns on a timely basis during your college years. If you have not already done so, create an FSA ID. Use the Data Retrieval Tool (DRT) to import your tax information to FAFSA. The DRT improves accuracy and reduces the likelihood of being selected for federal verification. TCU's school code for the FAFSA is 003636 . Complete the FAFSA How To File Your FAFSA Keep Up The Cost of Attendance for each academic year is updated each spring. The Net Price Calculator will help you determine your financial needs for the coming year. Net Cost Calculator Follow Up Check your email daily once you've applied for Federal Financial Aid to make sure everything is progressing. If your family income situation changes for any reason, please contact your financial aid advisor about how to modify your FAFSA and CSS Profiles. Submit Verification & Supporting Documents If there’s conflicting information between the FAFSA and the CSS Profile or if the U.S. Department of Education requires verification, you’ll need to submit the requested documents before your financial aid award can be finalized. You can view the status of your financial aid by logging on to my.tcu.edu . Check your email often to avoid delays should there be more documentation needed. All forms require an actual signature, electronic generated signatures are not accepted. Submitting your forms by upload through your TCU portal is preferred. Please only submit documents once. View & Accept Your Financial Aid Award Notification Financial aid awards are released via my.tcu.edu portal around June 1. You will receive an email once you have been awarded notifying you to log in to my.tcu.edu to view your Financial Aid Package. Check For Scholarships You might be surprised by the types of scholarships that exist. Scholarship listings evolve, so stay current in your search. You can review TCU scholarships, and use the resource page to investigate outside offerings. View TCU Scholarships Important Dates December Academic Scholarship notifications begin and continue through March. March 15 Free Application for Federal Financial Aid should be filed by this date to insure the results will be in the Financial Aid Office by May 1 for all returning students. May 1 Returning Student Priority Funding Deadline: If FAFSA is received by TCU on or before May 1, students will be evaluated for all types of need-based aid (grants, work-study and loans). FAFSA submitted after May 1 will be reviewed on a funds-available basis. Returning students do not need to apply for the CSS profile. May 31 Appeal applications are due in the Office of Scholarship and Student Financial Aid June 14 Students will be notified of the results of The Satisfactory Academic Appeals Committee June 20 Students will be notified of the results of The Scholarship Committee meeting to review appeals. July Bill for Fall term is sent via email from the Office of Student Financial Services. August 1 First payment for Fall term is due. October 1 FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) available for submission for upcoming academic year.
